rationale: Forge's imported panels fit authored layouts by scaling a retained view hierarchy, but gesture delivery converted root coordinates by subtracting bounds and dividing one accumulated scale. That ignored the root transform, per-view transform origins and the ordering of nested scroll offsets, so a control could paint and hit-test at one position while a drag or drop was delivered in another coordinate system. Gesture routing now reuses the retained pointer dispatcher and inverts each root-to-target transform in paint order, including scroll offsets, before delivering local coordinates. This is Pulp-only plug-in editor and imported-panel integration work: it fixes Forge/Pulp interaction routing for scaled generated panels and does not claim or backport a named immutable Vellum framework change.
